verdict.rationale: gstack is itself a skill pack distributed from a shared git repo. Its docs reference a vendored, project-local install that the upgrade skill detects and that coexists with a global install, which implies a team can commit it into a project. A community member also notes the git-clone-and-copy install model, which works well solo but may buckle when different repos need divergent review or QA gates. The only marketplace or registry evidence is a third-party user republishing it to the gitagent registry. missing for 10: explicit team-distribution docs (how to commit or vendor skills for a whole team), an official marketplace or plugin listing, guidance on distributing a customized standard skill set, and independent corroboration of team-wide rollout.
